ayahs.textUthmani: الٓمٓ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: الٓمٓ ۝١
ayahs.textIndopak: ال࢜مّ࢜ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Alif, Lām, Meem.[1170]
ayahs.transliteration: Alif-Laam-Meem
ayahs.translationClear: Alif, Lam, Meem.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيهِ مِن رَّبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ۝٢
ayahs.textIndopak: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رَّبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ؕ
ayahs.translation: [This is] the revelation of the Book about which there is no doubt from the Lord of the worlds.
ayahs.transliteration: Tanzeelul-kitaabi laa rayba feehi mir rabbil-'aalameen
ayahs.translationClear: The revelation of the Book, without a doubt, is from the Lord of the Universe.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمْ يَقُولُونَ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ‌ۚ بَلْ هُوَ ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ لِتُنذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّآ أَتَىٰهُم مِّن نَّذِيرٍ مِّن قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُونَ ۝٣
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمْ يَقُوْلُوْنَ افْتَرٰىهُۚ بَلْ هُوَ الْحَقُّ مِنْ رَّبِّكَ لِتُنْذِرَ قَوْمًا مَّا͏ٓ اَتٰىهُمْ مِّنْ نَّذِيْرٍ مِّنْ قَبْلِكَ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَهْتَدُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Or do they say, "He invented it"? Rather, it is the truth from your Lord, [O Muḥammad], that you may warn a people to whom no warner has come before you [so] perhaps they will be guided.
ayahs.transliteration: Am yaqooloonaftaraahu bal huwal-haqqu mir rabbika litundhira qawmam maa ataahum min nadheerim min qablika la'allahum yahtadoon
ayahs.translationClear: Yet they say, “He made it up.” In fact, it is the truth from your Lord, to warn a people who received no warner before you, that they may be guided.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ ٱسْتَوَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ‌ۖ مَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِهِۦ مِن وَلِىٍّ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ‌ۚ أَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ ۝٤
ayahs.textIndopak: اَللّٰهُ الَّذِيْ خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِيْ سِتَّةِ اَيَّامٍ ثُمَّ اسْتَوٰي عَلَي الْعَرْشِؕ مَا لَكُمْ مِّنْ دُوْنِهٖ مِنْ وَّلِيٍّ وَّلَا شَفِيْعٍؕ اَفَلَا تَتَذَكَّرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: It is Allāh who created the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them in six days; then He established Himself above the Throne.[1171] You have not besides Him any protector or any intercessor; so will you not be reminded?
ayahs.transliteration: Allaahul-ladhee khalaqas-samaawaati wal-arda wamaa baynahumaa fee sittati ayyaamin thummastawaa 'alal-'arshi maa lakum min doonihee min waliyyin walaa shafee'in afalaa tatadhakkaroon
ayahs.translationClear: Allah is He who created the heavens and the earth and everything between them in six days, and then established Himself on the Throne. Apart from Him, you have no master and no intercessor. Will you not reflect?

ayahs.textUthmani: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: يُدَبِّرُ ٱلْأَمْرَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥٓ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّونَ ۝٥
ayahs.textIndopak: يُدَبِّرُ الْاَمْرَ مِنَ السَّمَا࢜ءِ اِلَي الْاَرْضِ ثُمَّ يَعْرُجُ اِلَيْهِ فِيْ يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهٗٓ اَلْفَ سَنَةٍ مِّمَّا تَعُدُّوْنَ
ayahs.translation: He arranges [each] matter from the heaven to the earth; then it will ascend to Him in a Day, the extent of which is a thousand years of those which you count.
ayahs.transliteration: Yudabbirul-amra minas-samaa'i ilal-ardi thumma ya'ruju ilayhi fee yawmin kaana miqdaaruhoo alfa sanatim mimmaa ta'uddoon
ayahs.translationClear: He regulates all affairs, from the heavens, to the earth. Then it ascends to Him on a Day the length of which is a thousand years by your count.

ayahs.textUthmani: ذَٰلِكَ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ذَٰلِكَ عَـٰلِمُ ٱلْغَيْبِ وَٱلشَّهَـٰدَةِ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ۝٦
ayahs.textIndopak: ذٰلِكَ عٰلِمُ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ الْعَزِيْزُ الرَّحِيْمُ ۙ
ayahs.translation: That is the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
ayahs.transliteration: Dhaalika 'aalimul-ghaybi wash-shahaadatil-'azeezur-raheem
ayahs.translationClear: That is the Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Powerful, the Merciful.

ayahs.textUthmani: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ٱلَّذِىٓ أَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلَقَهُۥ‌ۖ وَبَدَأَ خَلْقَ ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ مِن طِينٍ ۝٧
ayahs.textIndopak: الَّذِيْٓ اَحْسَنَ كُلَّ شَيْءٍ خَلَقَهٗ وَبَدَاَ خَلْقَ الْاِنْسَانِ مِنْ طِيْنٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Who perfected everything which He created and began the creation of man from clay.
ayahs.transliteration: Al-ladhee ahsana kulla shay'in khalaqahoo wabada'a khalqal-insaani min teen
ayahs.translationClear: He who perfected everything He created, and originated the creation of man from clay.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهُۥ مِن سُلَـٰلَةٍ مِّن مَّآءٍ مَّهِينٍ ۝٨
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسْلَهٗ مِنْ سُلٰلَةٍ مِّنْ مَّا࢜ءٍ مَّهِيْنٍ ۚ
ayahs.translation: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma ja'ala naslahoo min sulaalatim mim maa'im maheen
ayahs.translationClear: Then made his reproduction from an extract of an insignificant fluid.

ayahs.textUthmani: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦ‌ۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمْعَ وَٱلْأَبْصَـٰرَ وَٱلْأَفْـِٔدَةَ‌ۚ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُونَ ۝٩
ayahs.textIndopak: ثُمَّ سَوّٰىهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيْهِ مِنْ رُّوْحِهٖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمْعَ وَالْاَبْصَارَ وَالْاَفْـِٕدَةَؕ قَلِيْلًا مَّا تَشْكُرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul[1172] and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
ayahs.transliteration: Thumma sawwaahu wanafakha feehi mir roohihee waja'ala lakumus-sam'a wal-absaara wal-af'idata qaleelam maa tashkuroon

footnotes.1172: i.e., element of life. See footnote to 15:29.

ayahs.translationClear: Then He proportioned him, and breathed into him of His spirit. Then He gave you the hearing, and the eyesight, and the brains—but rarely do you give thanks.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَقَالُوٓا۟ أَءِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَءِنَّا لَفِى خَلْقٍ جَدِيدٍۭ‌ۚ بَلْ هُم بِلِقَآءِ رَبِّهِمْ كَـٰفِرُونَ ۝١٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَقَالُوْٓا ءَاِذَا ضَلَلْنَا فِي الْاَرْضِ ءَاِنَّا لَفِيْ خَلْقٍ جَدِيْدٍ࣢ؕ بَلْ هُمْ بِلِقَا࢜ءِ رَبِّهِمْ كٰفِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When we are lost [i.e., disintegrated] within the earth, will we indeed be [recreated] in a new creation?" Rather, they are, in the meeting with their Lord, disbelievers.
ayahs.transliteration: Waqaaloo a'idhaa dalalnaa fil-ardi a'innaa lafee khalqin jadeedim bal hum biliqaa'i rabbihim kaafiroon
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “When we are lost into the earth, shall we be in a new creation?” In fact, they deny the meeting with their Lord.

ayahs.textUthmani: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: ۞ قُلْ يَتَوَفَّىٰكُم مَّلَكُ ٱلْمَوْتِ ٱلَّذِى وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُونَ ۝١١
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمْ مَّلَكُ الْمَوْتِ الَّذِيْ وُكِّلَ بِكُمْ ثُمَّ اِلٰي رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: Say, "The angel of death who has been entrusted with you will take you. Then to your Lord you will be returned."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yatawaffaakum malakul-mawtil-ladhee wukkila bikum thumma ilaa rabbikum turja'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “The angel of death put in charge of you will reclaim you. Then to your Lord you will be returned.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ تَرَىٰٓ إِذِ ٱلْمُجْرِمُونَ نَاكِسُوا۟ رُءُوسِهِمْ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ رَبَّنَآ أَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَٱرْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَـٰلِحًا إِنَّا مُوقِنُونَ ۝١٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ تَرٰٓي اِذِ الْمُجْرِمُوْنَ نَاكِسُوْا رُءُوْسِهِمْ عِنْدَ رَبِّهِمْؕ رَبَّنَا͏ٓ اَبْصَرْنَا وَسَمِعْنَا فَارْجِعْنَا نَعْمَلْ صَالِحًا اِنَّا مُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: If you could but see when the criminals are hanging their heads before their Lord, [saying], "Our Lord, we have seen and heard, so return us [to the world]; we will work righteousness. Indeed, we are [now] certain."
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw taraa idhil-mujrimoona naakisoo ru'oosihim 'inda rabbihim rabbanaa absarnaa wasami'naa farji'naa na'mal saalihan innaa mooqinoon
ayahs.translationClear: If only you could see the guilty, bowing their heads before their Lord: “Our Lord, we have seen and we have heard, so send us back, and we will act righteously; we are now convinced.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَوْ شِئْنَا لَـَٔاتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدَىٰهَا وَلَـٰكِنْ حَقَّ ٱلْقَوْلُ مِنِّى لَأَمْلَأَنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ ۝١٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَوْ شِي͏ٔ͏ْنَا لَاٰتَيْنَا كُلَّ نَفْسٍ هُدٰىهَا وَلٰكِنْ حَقَّ الْقَوْلُ مِنِّيْ لَاَمْلَـٔ͏َنَّ جَهَنَّمَ مِنَ الْجِنَّةِ وَالنَّاسِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And if We had willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the word[1173] from Me will come into effect [that] "I will surely fill Hell with jinn and people all together.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaw shi'naa la'aataynaa kulla nafsin hudaahaa walaakin haqqal-qawlu minnee la'amla'anna jahannama minal-jinnati wan-naasi ajma'een
ayahs.translationClear: Had We willed, We could have given every soul its guidance, but the declaration from Me will come true: “I will fill Hell with jinn and humans, all together.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَـٰكُمْ ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَذُوقُوا۟ بِمَا نَسِيتُمْ لِقَآءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هَـٰذَآ إِنَّا نَسِينَـٰكُمْ‌ۖ وَذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٤
ayahs.textIndopak: فَذُوْقُوْا بِمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَا࢜ءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَاۚ اِنَّا نَسِيْنٰكُمْ وَذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ الْخُلْدِ بِمَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: So taste [punishment] because you forgot the meeting of this, your Day; indeed, We have [accordingly] forgotten you. And taste the punishment of eternity for what you used to do."
ayahs.transliteration: Fadhooqoo bimaa naseetum liqaa'a yawmikum haadhaa innaa naseenaakum wadhooqoo 'adhaabal-khuldi bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: So taste, because you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours; We have forgotten you; so taste the eternal torment for what you used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّمَا يُؤْمِنُ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا ٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا ذُكِّرُوا۟ بِهَا خَرُّوا۟ سُجَّدًا وَسَبَّحُوا۟ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ ۩ ۝١٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّمَا يُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنُ بِاٰيٰتِنَا الَّذِيْنَ اِذَا ذُكِّرُوْا بِهَا خَرُّوْا سُجَّدًا وَّسَبَّحُوْا بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَهُمْ لَا يَسْتَكْبِرُوْنَ ࣛ
ayahs.translation: Only those believe in Our verses who, when they are reminded by them, fall down in prostration and exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord, and they are not arrogant.
ayahs.transliteration: Innamaa yu'minu bi'aayaatinal-ladheena idhaa dhukkiroo bihaa kharroo sujjadan wasabbahoo bihamdi rabbihim wahum laa yastakbiroon
ayahs.translationClear: They believe in Our communications, those who, when reminded of them, fall down prostrate, and glorify their Lord with praise, and are not proud.

ayahs.textUthmani: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: تَتَجَافَىٰ جُنُوبُهُمْ عَنِ ٱلْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُونَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَطَمَعًا وَمِمَّا رَزَقْنَـٰهُمْ يُنفِقُونَ ۝١٦
ayahs.textIndopak: تَتَجَافٰي جُنُوْبُهُمْ عَنِ الْمَضَاجِعِ يَدْعُوْنَ رَبَّهُمْ خَوْفًا وَّطَمَعًاؗ وَّمِمَّا رَزَقْنٰهُمْ يُنْفِقُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Their sides part [i.e., they arise] from [their] beds; they supplicate their Lord in fear and aspiration, and from what We have provided them, they spend.[1174]
ayahs.transliteration: Tatajaafaa junoobuhum 'anil-madaaji'i yad'oona rabbahum khawfan watama'an wamimmaa razaqnaahum yunfiqoon
ayahs.translationClear: Their sides shun their beds, as they pray to their Lord, out of reverence and hope; and from Our provisions to them, they give.

ayahs.textUthmani: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أُخْفِىَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعْيُنٍ جَزَآءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٧
ayahs.textIndopak: فَلَا تَعْلَمُ نَفْسٌ مَّا͏ٓ اُخْفِيَ لَهُمْ مِّنْ قُرَّةِ اَعْيُنٍۚ جَزَا࢜ءًۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes [i.e., satisfaction] as reward for what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: Falaa ta'lamu nafsum maa ukhfiya lahum min qurrati a'yunin jazaa'am bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: No soul knows what eye’s delight awaits them—a reward for what they used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَفَمَن كَانَ مُؤْمِنًا كَمَن كَانَ فَاسِقًا‌ۚ لَّا يَسْتَوُۥنَ ۝١٨
ayahs.textIndopak: اَفَمَنْ كَانَ مُو͏ٔ͏ْمِنًا كَمَنْ كَانَ فَاسِقًاؕؔ لَا يَسْتَوٗنَ ؔ
ayahs.translation: Then is one who was a believer like one who was defiantly disobedient? They are not equal.
ayahs.transliteration: Afaman kaana mu'minan kaman kaana faasiqal laa yastawoon
ayahs.translationClear: Is someone who is faithful like someone who is a sinner? They are not equal.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ ۝١٩
ayahs.textIndopak: اَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنّٰتُ الْمَاْوٰيؗ نُزُلًاۢ بِمَا كَانُوْا يَعْمَلُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.
ayahs.transliteration: Ammal-ladheena aamanoo wa'amilus-saalihaati falahum jannaatul-ma'waa nuzulam bimaa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.translationClear: As for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for them are the Gardens of Shelter—hospitality for what they used to do.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فَسَقُوا۟ فَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ‌ۖ كُلَّمَآ أَرَادُوٓا۟ أَن يَخْرُجُوا۟ مِنْهَآ أُعِيدُوا۟ فِيهَا وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ ذُوقُوا۟ عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ ٱلَّذِى كُنتُم بِهِۦ تُكَذِّبُونَ ۝٢٠
ayahs.textIndopak: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ فَسَقُوْا فَمَاْوٰىهُمُ النَّارُؕ كُلَّمَا͏ٓ اَرَادُوْٓا اَنْ يَّخْرُجُوْا مِنْهَا͏ٓ اُعِيْدُوْا فِيْهَا وَقِيْلَ لَهُمْ ذُوْقُوْا عَذَابَ النَّارِ الَّذِيْ كُنْتُمْ بِهٖ تُكَذِّبُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: But as for those who defiantly disobeyed, their refuge is the Fire. Every time they wish to emerge from it, they will be returned to it while it is said to them, "Taste the punishment of the Fire which you used to deny."
ayahs.transliteration: Wa'ammal-ladheena fasaqoo fama'waahumun-naaru kullamaa araadoo an yakhrujoo minhaa u'eedoo feehaa waqeela lahum dhooqoo 'adhaaban-naaril-ladhee kuntum bihee tukadhdhiboon
ayahs.translationClear: But as for those who transgressed, their shelter is the Fire. Every time they try to get out of it, they will be brought back into it, and it will be said to them, “Taste the suffering of the Fire which you used to deny.”

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَنُذِيقَنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَدْنَىٰ دُونَ ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلْأَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ ۝٢١
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَنُذِيْقَنَّهُمْ مِّنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَدْنٰي دُوْنَ الْعَذَابِ الْاَكْبَرِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُوْنَ

words.translation: And surely, We will let them taste

ayahs.translation: And We will surely let them taste the nearer punishment[1175] short of the greater punishment that perhaps they will return [i.e., repent].
ayahs.transliteration: Walanudheeqannahum minal-'adhaabil-adnaa doonal-'adhaabil-akbari la'allahum yarji'oon

footnotes.1175: i.e., the disasters and calamities of this world.

ayahs.translationClear: We will make them taste the lesser torment, prior to the greater torment, so that they may return.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَمَنْ أَظْلَمُ مِمَّن ذُكِّرَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ثُمَّ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهَآ‌ۚ إِنَّا مِنَ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ مُنتَقِمُونَ ۝٢٢
ayahs.textIndopak: وَمَنْ اَظْلَمُ مِمَّنْ ذُكِّرَ بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهٖ ثُمَّ اَعْرَضَ عَنْهَاؕ اِنَّا مِنَ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ مُنْتَقِمُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord; then he turns away from them? Indeed We, from the criminals, will take retribution.
ayahs.transliteration: Waman azlamu mimman dhukkira bi'aayaati rabbihee thumma a'rada 'anhaa innaa minal-mujrimeena muntaqimoon
ayahs.translationClear: Who is more wrong than he, who, when reminded of his Lord’s revelations, turns away from them? We will certainly wreak vengeance upon the criminals.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ ۖ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ فَلَا تَكُن فِى مِرْيَةٍ مِّن لِّقَآئِهِۦ‌ۖ وَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ هُدًى لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ۝٢٣
ayahs.textIndopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا مُوْسَي الْكِتٰبَ فَلَا تَكُنْ فِيْ مِرْيَةٍ مِّنْ لِّقَا࢜ىِٕهٖ وَجَعَلْنٰهُ هُدًي لِّبَنِيْٓ اِسْرَا࢜ءِيْلَ ۚ
ayahs.translation: And We certainly gave Moses the Scripture, so do not be in doubt over his meeting.[1176] And We made it [i.e., the Torah] guidance for the Children of Israel.
ayahs.transliteration: Walaqad aataynaa moosal-kitaaba falaa takun fee miryatim mil liqaa'ihee waja'alnaahu hudal libanee israa'eel

footnotes.1176: i.e., Muḥammad's meeting Moses on the night of al-Miʿrāj (ascent).

ayahs.translationClear: We gave Moses the Book; so do not be in doubt regarding His encounter; and We made it a guidance for the Children of Israel.

ayahs.textUthmani: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟ ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ أَئِمَّةً يَهْدُونَ بِأَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوا۟‌ۖ وَكَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا يُوقِنُونَ ۝٢٤
ayahs.textIndopak: وَجَعَلْنَا مِنْهُمْ اَىِٕمَّةً يَّهْدُوْنَ بِاَمْرِنَا لَمَّا صَبَرُوْاࣞؕ وَكَانُوْا بِاٰيٰتِنَا يُوْقِنُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: And We made from among them leaders guiding by Our command when they were patient and [when] they were certain of Our signs.
ayahs.transliteration: Waja'alnaa minhum a'immatan yahdoona bi'amrinaa lammaa sabaroo wakaanoo bi'aayaatinaa yooqinoon
ayahs.translationClear: And We appointed leaders from among them, guiding by Our command, as long as they persevered and were certain of Our communications.

ayahs.textUthmani: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ ۝٢٥
ayahs.textIndopak: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَفْصِلُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
ayahs.transliteration: Inna rabbaka huwa yafsilu baynahum yawmal-qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
ayahs.translationClear: Your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection regarding everything they had disputed.

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَبْلِهِم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ‌ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ‌ۖ أَفَلَا يَسْمَعُونَ ۝٢٦
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ اَهْلَكْنَا مِنْ قَبْلِهِمْ مِّنَ الْقُرُوْنِ يَمْشُوْنَ فِيْ مَسٰكِنِهِمْؕ اِنَّ فِيْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍؕ اَفَلَا يَسْمَعُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them, [as] they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs; then do they not hear?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknaa min qablihim minal-qurooni yamshoona fee masaakinihim inna fee dhaalika la'aayaatin afalaa yasma'oon
ayahs.translationClear: Is it not a lesson for them, how many generations We have destroyed before them, in whose habitations they walk? Surely in that are signs. Do they not hear?

ayahs.textUthmani: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَـٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ أَنَّا نَسُوقُ ٱلْمَآءَ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهِۦ زَرْعًا تَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ أَنْعَـٰمُهُمْ وَأَنفُسُهُمْ‌ۖ أَفَلَا يُبْصِرُونَ ۝٢٧
ayahs.textIndopak: اَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا اَنَّا نَسُوْقُ الْمَا࢜ءَ اِلَي الْاَرْضِ الْجُرُزِ فَنُخْرِجُ بِهٖ زَرْعًا تَاْكُلُ مِنْهُ اَنْعَامُهُمْ وَاَنْفُسُهُمْؕ اَفَلَا يُبْصِرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Have they not seen that We drive water [in clouds] to barren land and bring forth thereby crops from which their livestock eat and [they] themselves? Then do they not see?
ayahs.transliteration: Awalam yaraw annaa nasooqul-maa'a ilal-ardil-juruzi fanukhriju bihee zar'an ta'kulu minhu an'aamuhum wa'anfusuhum afalaa yubsiroon
ayahs.translationClear: Do they not see how We conduct the water to a dry land, and with it We produce vegetation, from which their livestock eat, and themselves? Do they not see?

ayahs.textUthmani: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: وَيَقُولُونَ مَتَىٰ هَـٰذَا ٱلْفَتْحُ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ ۝٢٨
ayahs.textIndopak: وَيَقُوْلُوْنَ مَتٰي هٰذَا الْفَتْحُ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
ayahs.translation: And they say, "When will be this conquest,[1177] if you should be truthful?"
ayahs.transliteration: Wayaqooloona mataa haadhal-fat'hu in kuntum saadiqeen
ayahs.translationClear: And they say, “When is this victory, if you are truthful?”

ayahs.textUthmani: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: قُلْ يَوْمَ ٱلْفَتْحِ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِيمَـٰنُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ ۝٢٩
ayahs.textIndopak: قُلْ يَوْمَ الْفَتْحِ لَا يَنْفَعُ الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْٓا اِيْمَانُهُمْ وَلَا هُمْ يُنْظَرُوْنَ
ayahs.translation: Say, [O Muḥammad], "On the Day of Conquest the belief of those who had disbelieved will not benefit them, nor will they be reprieved."
ayahs.transliteration: Qul yawmal-fat'hi laa yanfa'ul-ladheena kafaroo eemaanuhum walaa hum yunzaroon
ayahs.translationClear: Say, “On the day of victory, the faith of those who disbelieved will be of no avail to them, and they will not be granted respite.”

ayahs.textUthmani: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ
ayahs.textUthmaniTajweed: فَأَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَٱنتَظِرْ إِنَّهُم مُّنتَظِرُونَ ۝٣٠
ayahs.textIndopak: فَاَعْرِضْ عَنْهُمْ وَانْتَظِرْ اِنَّهُمْ مُّنْتَظِرُوْنَ ࣖ
ayahs.translation: So turn away from them and wait. Indeed, they are waiting.
ayahs.transliteration: Fa'a'rid 'anhum wantazir innahum muntaziroon
ayahs.translationClear: So turn away from them, and wait. They too are waiting.
